name: Veloria
description:
The Vibe: Radiant, uplifting, and as refreshing as a gentle ocean breeze.

The Scent Journey: Blooms instantly with the delicate, soft elegance of fresh roses and bright floral notes, brightened by a sparkling splash of citrus. Clean, aquatic nuances bring a wave of airy freshness, while subtle woody undertones and a touch of fresh spice ground the scent with absolute sophistication.

Best For: The woman who loves a graceful, fresh-spirited floral fragrance.
